column1: # air_iso.tsv: per-scan CT air / papyrus iso (ufsm ct-iso, DESIGN 2026-11-17 "per-scroll air iso"). One row per scan and level; key without
# volumes/ (match on the zarr's basename). 8^3 grid of 128^3 boxes per level (boxes under 10 % nonzero skipped), 0 dropped, sigma-3 smoothing;
# air = highest local max in [32, 90], valley = first minimum above it, pap = the next maximum, mid = (air + pap + 1) / 2 (packed-region iso),
# depth = valley / smaller peak. Levels: the fields level (~9 um: L2 of the 2.2-2.4 um scans, L0 of the 7.9-9.4 um scans) and L0 / L1
# where the ink teachers read. Regenerate one row: ufsm ct-iso ROOT KEY LEVEL --scroll SCROLL
